cases.input_summary: An exact production package version resolves from an approved registry with verified publisher, registry digest, consistent lockfile, and completed current intelligence checks.

expected.reason: All policy-required evidence is attributable to the exact package version and artifact.

cases.input_summary: The resolved artifact digest differs from the approved registry digest for the exact package version.

expected.reason: An exact attributable integrity mismatch satisfies a blocking candidate.

cases.input_summary: A new package name resembles a popular dependency, but publisher, version, artifact, and intelligence evidence are unavailable.

expected.reason: Name similarity is a review signal, not proof of hallucination, typosquatting, or malware.

cases.input_summary: An authorization fix has independently derived positive, cross-tenant negative, boundary, and old-code-fail/new-code-pass regression tests with durable-state assertions.

expected.reason: Tests demonstrate the security outcome and discriminate the corrected behavior from the vulnerable baseline.

cases.input_summary: An object-level authorization change has only a successful owner-access test asserting HTTP 200.

expected.reason: A passing happy path does not prove unauthorized access is denied or state remains protected.

cases.input_summary: The security behavior is identifiable, but the test helper and CI execution record are unavailable and the repository command cannot be safely established.

expected.reason: Unavailable test and execution evidence cannot be converted into sufficient assurance.
